room_description: Stay in our newly renovated Deluxe Rooms, thoughtfully designed for quiet and intimate accommodation. Located in the Lake Wing, guests may choose between a King, Twin, or Queen bed to suit their preference. Each room offers views of Aguinaldo Highway or the hotel’s charming courtyard, with easy access to our exclusive gate to Skyranch for added leisure. The renovation includes a modern new look with upgraded flooring, ceiling, and wall finishes, stylish furniture and fixtures, improved blackout and sheer curtains, and an upgraded bathroom. Guests can also enjoy a larger 55” smart TV, a new minibar, enhanced ventilation and lighting, plus in-room technology with occupancy sensors for a more seamless stay.

Unwind in the newly renovated Premier Queen Room, thoughtfully designed with two queen-size beds to welcome families, friends, or couples. Located in the Lake Wing, the room features a private balcony that frames breathtaking views of Taal Volcano lake. Guests also enjoy the convenience of an exclusive Skyranch gate, making every getaway both relaxing and fun. With its refreshed interiors, upgraded furnishings, new curtains, and modern bathroom, this room blends style with comfort. Enhanced amenities such as a 55” smart TV, minibar, and advanced in-room technology ensure a cozy and memorable stay.

Ideal for families or small groups, the newly renovated Two-Bedroom Deluxe Suite offers generous space and stylish comfort in the Lake Wing. Overlooking the hotel’s courtyard, this suite keeps everyone connected while still offering the privacy of separate rooms. Guests also enjoy easy access to our exclusive Skyranch gate, adding fun and convenience to their Tagaytay getaway. The suite’s renovation features upgraded flooring, ceiling, and wall finishes, new blackout and sheer curtains, a refreshed minibar, and enhanced bathrooms. Modern amenities such as a 55” smart TV, upgraded ventilation and lighting, and in-room technology make it a perfect blend of homelike warmth and hotel luxury.

Celebrate life’s milestones or simply unwind in the newly renovated Batangas Suite, an 84-square-meter haven in the Lake Wing. Enjoy a bathtub for indulgent relaxation, a private balcony with panoramic views of Taal Volcano and the lake, and a separate living room with a guest bathroom. With convenient access to our exclusive Skyranch gate, experience both serenity and leisure in one stay. The refreshed suite features elegant finishes, stylish furnishings, blackout and sheer curtains, an upgraded minibar, and enhanced in-room technology, including a 55” smart TV, Nespresso coffee machine, and improved lighting for a modern, comfortable retreat.

Surrounded by the refreshing view of lush greenery, the Superior Room offers a relaxing retreat with your choice of a Superior King featuring one king-size bed, or a Superior Twin with two single beds. Each room is thoughtfully designed with a comfy duvet and fluffy pillows to ensure a restful night’s sleep. The bathroom showcases a modern, well-appointed design, complete with both a rain shower and a handheld showerhead for added comfort. Conveniently located near the swimming pool, the Superior Room provides easy access to leisure and relaxation.

Located on a higher floor, the rooms are tastefully furnished and offer a better view of the ridge. It features a single king-sized bed, a comfy duvet, and fluffy pillows for a refreshing sleep. The bathroom is equipped with complete amenities, including a rain shower and handheld shower fixtures.

Inspired by the rich culture and relaxing outdoor vibe of Tagaytay, the Ridge Rooms embody a perfect balance of comfort, style, and functionality. Each room features one king bed and one single bed, offering a cozy retreat for friends, groups, or small families. Located at the Mountain Wing, the Ridge Room is the only room type with a private balcony, where guests can unwind and take in the soothing views of nature. Please note that PWDs and senior citizens may require assistance to access our Ridge Rooms.

For a more captivating and serene stay, our Premier Room offers amenities that make you feel right at home. It features a queen-sized bed complemented by a cozy duvet and fluffy pillows for a refreshing night’s sleep. The room also includes a mini living area with a sofa and table for added comfort. The bathroom features a modern, well-appointed design, complete with both a rain shower and a handheld showerhead for added comfort. Conveniently located near the swimming pool, Taza Fresh Table, and Rain Spa, the Premier Room offers easy access to leisure and relaxation.

Features a spacious living room and the privacy of a master’s bedroom, complete with a roomy open closet, a modern bathroom with both rain and handheld showerheads, and an ultra-comfy king-size bed with a plush duvet and fluffy pillows for a restful sleep. The room also includes added conveniences such as a premium Nespresso coffee machine and a complimentary minibar. For larger groups or added comfort, this accommodation can also be upgraded to a Two-Bedroom Deluxe Suite.

Features a modern and fresh vibe with floor-to-ceiling glass windows that provide an awe-inspiring view of Taal Lake and Volcano. The master’s bedroom has a king-size bed with a comfy duvet and fluffy pillows for a revitalizing sleep, a spacious open closet, and a modern bathroom with both rain and handheld showerheads. The living area, offering a magnificent view, is an ideal place for family catch-up moments. The suite also includes added conveniences such as a premium Nespresso coffee machine and a complimentary minibar. It has a provision for an additional connecting room with twin beds. For larger groups or added comfort, this accommodation can also be upgraded to a Taal Two-Bedroom Suite.

A luxurious 196 square-meter space with contemporary vibe – highlighting an extended floor to ceiling glass windows with panoramic view of the majestic Taal Volcano. The modish master’s bedroom features a roomy open closet, a king size bed with fluffy pillows and comfy duvet for a heavenly sleep. The suite features a dining area with its own pantry as well as a spacious living area with entertainment facilities – an ideal place for family and group gatherings. A full executive working table is provided should you need to catch up on work. The stylish bathroom features both rain shower and hand held shower head fixtures. The suite offers the convenience of added amenities including premium Nespresso coffee machine and complimentary minibar. It also has a provision for additional connecting room with twin beds. For larger groups or added comfort, this accommodation can also be upgraded to a Tagaytay Two-Bedroom Suite.
